mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 43 degrees under clear skies by the Military Ridge State Trail, and with the moon in a waxing gibbous phase, you can expect an overnight low of 38 degrees with no rain predicted.
The City of Verona is moving forward with a new Public Works and Utilities facility to better serve our growing population, while road construction continues on Mark Drive and Legion Street.

There is plenty to do this week with live music at Bailey's Run tomorrow, Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and Paddy Mac's on November 21, followed by yoga and multiple trivia options throughout the weekend.
On November 2, officers were dispatched to West End Circle for a domestic disturbance that resulted in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.

Today's flavor was the sweet and tasty Double Strawberry. Since the store is closed for the night, we invite you to stop by tomorrow when the doors open at 10:00 AM to enjoy the flavor of the day, Really Reese's.
